{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Alay Makcheesas''''' was the name given to the earliest matches of [[Huttball]], before rules were codified. "''Alay Makcheesas''" was [[Huttese]] for "late payoffs," reflecting the fact that these violent matches were originally created as a means to get debtors to repay their loans.<ref name="Sports2">{{SW|url=news/take-me-out-to-the-ballgame-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-2|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 2: Take Me Out to the Ball Game|nolive=1}}</ref>
